new_mechanism_correction.correction: The round-14 note about a 'page bias high when V & 0xffff < 0x8000' was a misgeneralisation from a lw case. The correct rule is simple: the assembler computes hi = (V + 0x8000) >> 16 and lo16 = V & 0xffff, and it reproduces whatever (hi, signed lo) pair you ask for as long as the symbol sits at V = (hi << 16) + sign_extend(lo) - i.e. the SAME no-carry value already used for lui+lw globals. This is consistent for addiu-materialized constants in every case measured.
worked_examples: 001618b8 target `lui a2,0x1e` + `addiu a2,a2,-9608` => declare func_001dda78 (the no-carry value, which happens to equal Ghidra's).
new_mechanism_correction.the_lw_case_is_different: For lui+lw/lw+sw the pair must satisfy hi == V >> 16 exactly, and the assembler's conservative hi is one page high when V & 0xffff >= 0x8000. That is why the no-carry convention exists for globals and why a symbol named after the TRUE address produced `lui t7,0x1d6` + `lw a1,-29296(t7)` in round 14.
new_mechanism_correction.name_requirement: func_ names must be exactly 8 hex digits or the harness does not auto-define them and the link fails - a 7-digit name such as func_01dda78 is silently undefined.

00198700.reason: a do/while whose loop variable is the call RESULT and whose incoming a0 is never updated; the target's back-edge delay slot is a nop, confirming a0 is not rewritten. GCC hoists the live-in `move v0,a0` into the prologue above `sd ra`. v02 (callee takes no argument, 48/56), v03 (result kept in a separate variable, 64/56) and v06 (memory barrier after the prologue, 52/56 with the same 12-word cascade) all regressed.

001ca950.reason: the callee's second value arrives in $t1 in the jal delay slot (`move s1,t1`) - a non-O32 argument register, same not-expressible-in-C class as 002ba3b8, 001231f8 and 00158050.

0028b7f8.reason: target `sd s0,0(sp) ; sd ra,8(sp) ; sw t7,0(a0)`; GCC emits the store between the two prologue saves. v03 (barrier after the prologue), v04 (barrier between the store and the first call) and v05 (two barriers) all widened the gap.

00307fe0.reason: only the scratch register holding the third parameter differs (target `move v0,a2` / `move a3,v0`, compiled `move t7,a2` / `move a3,t7`); every other instruction and the whole 32-byte frame match.

0030df00.reason: the code constant is exact via the symbol-address mechanism; the remainder is the DAT scratch register (target `lui v0,0x36` + `sw v1,24960(v0)`, compiled `lui t6,0x36` + `sw t7,24960(t6)` with -1 materialised into t7) - the fourth occurrence of the $v0-vs-$t7 pattern.

002b7f84.reason: leaf frame-pointer idiom (`sd s8; move s8,sp; ... move sp,s8; ld s8`), plus a redundant `move t7,v0; move v0,t7` pair the compiler never emits from C.

002b823c.reason: leaf frame-pointer idiom AND a gp-relative `lw t7,-7460(gp)`, which the probe harness cannot place.
